data_fields.name: arrow_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: none (donor has no cap; one arrow per hidden enemy)

best_idea: A ring of arrows around the hero, one per foe the player cannot see, fanned so they never stack and shown only in the fight state that needs them.
decision_why: The arrow ring fits many-on-one fights (foes behind a wall or outside the view, and the queue beyond MAX_ATTACKERS = 3), but the donor's hidden is a designer flag, the spread overlaps for two arrows, and the counter is written only on enter. Frankendom takes the shape with engine-derived visibility, a fixed spread, a cap as zone data and a count derived from the ledger.
acceptance: A hero with two foes behind a wall sees two arrows fanned apart around the hero, pointing at them; with the setting off no arrow appears; a test asserts that the first three arrows have distinct positions and that the remaining count drops on each defeat.
